deficiencies.description: The rewrite turns the lecturer's separate pointing statements into a spatial description that links the tumour to the outer surface of the uterus, and incorrectly describes the outer surface as having a very thin muscle wall.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus. This is normally a very thin muscle wall that is present in the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, which normally has a very thin muscle wall.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The text uses 'circumspect', which is a speaker slip or transcription error for 'circumscribed'. The rewrite correctly uses 'circumscribed', which is scientifically accurate in this context.

considerations.sourcePassage: has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: The idiom 'if you like' is changed to 'in a sense', which carries the same meaning and acts as a suitable hedge.
